title: Trump: RFK vaccine advisors lie about flu vaccine amid vote

The Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices voted on June 26, 2025 to recommend single-dose influenza vaccines without thimerosal for children, pregnant women, and other adults. The linked timeline places the votes after Robert F. Kennedy Jr. replaced the committee's membership. The discussion centered on a preservative and allegations about its safety.
